        that are the hallmarks of its history and the tradition it has followed since its foundation.

        Creating Value Together with the Supply Chain
                                                                                                                                                 Another major initiative is the Obayashi Rin-yu-kai

        Executive Officers                                                                                                                         Obayashi believes that transparency and sound management, along with a strong corporate governance framework, are
                                                                                                                                                   critical to maintaining society’s trust. By enhancing corporate governance, we are also able to achieve sustainable growth and
                                                                                                                                                   greater corporate value over the medium-to long-term. One specific aspect is to engage in transparent, fair, rapid, and
        President and CEO                                                                                                                          resolute decision-making. Such decision-making is always based on the principles of Japan’s Corporate Governance Code as
        Kenji Hasuwa                                                                                                                               set out by the Tokyo Stock Exchange, laws and regulations, and society’s expectations.
